issuerName.title: Issuer
issuerName.description: Name of the company or fund raising money.

cik.title: CIK
cik.description: SEC Central Index Key of the issuer (no leading zeros).

filingDate.title: Filed
filingDate.description: Date the filing was accepted by EDGAR (YYYY-MM-DD).

isAmendment.title: Amendment
isAmendment.description: True for a Form D/A amending an earlier notice.

previousAccessionNumber.title: Amends
previousAccessionNumber.description: Accession number of the filing this amendment replaces.

entityType.title: Entity type
entityType.description: Corporation, Limited Liability Company, Limited Partnership, etc.

yearOfIncorporation.title: Year inc.
yearOfIncorporation.description: Year of incorporation (reported for issuers formed within five years).

incorporatedWithinFiveYears.title: < 5 years old
incorporatedWithinFiveYears.description: True if the issuer was formed within the last five years.

address.title: Address
address.description: Principal place of business: street, street2, city, state (code), stateName, zip.

industryGroup.title: Industry
industryGroup.description: Form D industry group, e.g. Other Technology, Biotechnology, Pooled Investment Fund.

industryCategory.title: Category
industryCategory.description: Parent category of the industry group, e.g. Technology, Health Care.

investmentFundType.title: Fund type
investmentFundType.description: For pooled investment funds: Hedge Fund, Private Equity Fund, Venture Capital Fund or Other Investment Fund.

revenueRange.title: Revenue / NAV
revenueRange.description: Revenue range (or net asset value range for funds), often Decline to Disclose.

securityTypes.title: Securities
securityTypes.description: Types of securities offered, e.g. Equity, Debt, Other: SAFE.

dateOfFirstSale.title: First sale
dateOfFirstSale.description: Date of first sale (YYYY-MM-DD); null if it has yet to occur.

totalOfferingAmount.title: Offering ($)
totalOfferingAmount.description: Total offering amount in USD; null when Indefinite.

offeringAmountIndefinite.title: Indefinite
offeringAmountIndefinite.description: True if the offering amount is reported as Indefinite (common for funds).

totalRemaining.title: Remaining ($)
totalRemaining.description: Amount remaining to be sold in USD; null when Indefinite.

minimumInvestment.title: Min investment ($)
minimumInvestment.description: Minimum investment accepted from an outside investor, in USD.

totalInvestors.title: Investors
totalInvestors.description: Number of investors who have already invested.

nonAccreditedInvestors.title: Non-accredited
nonAccreditedInvestors.description: Number of non-accredited investors (0 if none).

exemptions.title: Exemptions
exemptions.description: Federal exemptions claimed: 06b = Rule 506(b), 06c = 506(c), 04 = Rule 504, 3C/3C.1/3C.7 = Investment Company Act 3(c) exclusions, 4a5 = Section 4(a)(5).

relatedPersons.title: Related persons
relatedPersons.description: Executive officers, directors and promoters: name, roles, title, city, state.

salesRecipients.title: Placement agents
salesRecipients.description: Brokers or finders paid sales compensation: name, crdNumber, brokerDealer, brokerDealerCrd.

otherIssuers.title: Co-issuers
otherIssuers.description: Names of additional issuers on the same filing.

xmlUrl.title: XML
xmlUrl.description: Form D primary_doc.xml with every reported field.
